body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Vonage presented a USB-type ‘Vonage V-Phone’ during CES 2007. It offers Vonage phone book and it can be also used as a portable storage. It features include pre-loaded Vonage Talk software, a detachable stereo earpiece microphone, and 250MB memory capacity and a new Vonage phone number.
